step1.description:
Today on PodRocket, we have Ryan Carniato (@ryansolid) creator of SolidJS, here to talk about a decade of SolidJS.

In this episode, Ryan talks about

* The history of SolidJS
* Its success on the heels of React Hooks
* How signals may be the web primitive we really need
